statement: For the Conradi-Mincheva-Shiu mixed-mechanism mass-action model, at Table 1 rates (1,1,1,1,100,1,9/10,3,1,100), total phosphatase 8 and total substrate 40, every finite total kinase K >= 4660166/209569 has a unique positive equilibrium with exactly two right-half-plane and four left-half-plane eigenvalues on the six-dimensional compatibility class, counting algebraic multiplicity.
scope: Exact equilibrium bound plus interval-certified local attracting cycle, eventual finite-K persistence and a strictly positive first period correction. Full original conjecture unresolved.

evidence.numerical_periodic_orbits: Selected finite-K trajectories and extrema remain floating-point illustrations; the separate limiting cycle/period coefficient is interval-certified
evidence.validated_periodic_orbit: CAPD Linux x86/GCC/FILIB, interval Krawczyk/derivative certificate and independently widened exact postprocessing

status.novelty_and_priority: unconfirmed; qualitative robustness overlaps 2023/2025 conference work; no strict model-specific T1 enclosure found in inspected sources

additional_results.attracting_periodic_orbit: There exists K0 such that every finite K>K0 admits a strictly positive orbitally asymptotically stable periodic orbit within its fixed compatibility class (K,8,40).
additional_results.period_expansion: T(K)=T_infinity+T1/K+O(K^-2) on the continued local branch in physical model time
